decision: Quaternius Universal Base Characters + Universal Animation Library (CC0) as the assets
why: CC0 on source page and License.txt; one 65-joint skeleton shared by bodies, hair and 43 clips incl idle/walk/sit/crouch

decision: Bake texture detail into vertex colours; ship no textures
why: PNG textures are 1-4 MB each and KTX2 needs a toolchain; at 120 px vertex shade+garment mask is enough and recolours per person on CPU

decision: Move palette logic to lib/avatar.ts keeping the rng draw order
why: SVG must draw the same pixels (pnpm visual rome-1000bce-person) and 3D must agree with it
